title: Threshold bounds for majority
statement: For every $\varepsilon>0$, there is a constant $C\ge0$ such that $2e^{-2C^2}\le\varepsilon$ and, for every natural number $m$ satisfying $C/\sqrt{2m+1}\le1/2$, the biased minus-probability polynomial of majority on $2m+1$ bits is at most $\varepsilon$ at bias parameter $p=1/2-C/\sqrt{2m+1}$, and is at least $1-\varepsilon$ at $p=1/2+C/\sqrt{2m+1}$.
